en: Black‑and‑white view of a small European town in a steep, green valley beside a river. In the foreground a concrete bridge crosses the river, leading into the town. At the right stands a prominent church with a tall, narrow bell tower and steep tiled roof along the riverside road. Behind the town rise terraced hillsides and rocky cliffs dotted with houses. On the left, industrial buildings with tall chimneys emit smoke against the cliff. The overall look is mid‑20th‑century rural‑industrial Europe.
